name: tomshaw
description: Tom Shaw's Claude Code plugins: mods built on function hooks, and later skills, agents and commands.

plugins.name: proofread
plugins.description: Fixes spelling and grammar in your prompt before it reaches Claude, and draws your prompts in a highlighted box with the fixed words called out. /proofread turns it on or off.

plugins.name: work-journal
plugins.description: Daily, weekly and monthly reviews of your work in Claude Code, summarized from the prompts you typed: projects, threads, decisions and open items. /journal opens it in a pane, /journal web as a webpage.

plugins.name: commit-summary
plugins.description: Summarizes git commits for a day, week or month (today by default), for everyone or one author, grouped by theme with line counts and highlights.
